questions.question: When Jacob gathered his twelve sons near the end of his life, what did he say he would tell them?

answers.text: What will happen to them in the days to come

Why the whole family must leave Egypt

questions.question: When Jacob blessed his son Judah, what did he say Judah's brothers would do?

answers.text: Praise him and bow down to him
Turn on him and drive him out
Forget him and leave him behind
